column1: # Paid-module images that go into each offline release bundle, and which
# version of each. Read by the `offline-bundle` job in .github/workflows/release.yml.
# A pin, not "latest": a release is a reviewed set of versions, and bumping
# one is a line in a pull request. Each image must already be on
# ghcr.io/ignite-ember/<name> under that version tag — an unprefixed tag,
# which only a module's `main` branch pushes — signed with the release
# cosign key and carrying a CycloneDX attestation. Its own repository's CD
# does that. The bundle job refuses any image that is not.
